exposure: labor induction by Foley catheter balloon (FCB) insertion
finding: Both labor induction methods resulted in similar rates of vaginal delivery within 24 hours and cesarean section, but the FCB induction method led to a shorter time to active labor and a lower rate of cesarean section in nulliparous women.
mod_finding: For nulliparous women, the FCB induction method had the advantage of a shorter time to active labor and a lower rate of cesarean section.
